extracted.name: Old Fashioned Pea Salad
extracted.description: This simple cold pea salad is a great accompaniment to grilled meats, cold sandwiches, or fried chicken.
ingredient_lines: salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Combine peas, onion, hard-cooked eggs, and mayonnaise in a large bowl. Stir well to combine. Season with salt and pepper. Chill for one hour before serving.
